stories.title: Show HN: Fast deterministic natural language search for OpenStreetMap data
stories.description: A free map for the web and Android: search places in plain words, place pages with photos and opening hours, directions by car, bike and on foot, public transport in Europe and spoken navigation.

stories.title: Delhi government formally notifies 24-member Medical Council
stories.description: The council is the regulatory body responsible for matters concerning the registration of medical practitioners and professional conduct and ethics in Delhi.

stories.title: Plea seeks awareness of health risks of marriages between blood relatives; Supreme Court calls for govt reply
stories.description: Supreme Court said restricting such marriages is a matter for Parliament, but issued notice on whether legislation or public outreach could promote awareness.

stories.title: Iron chest found during work at Indore's Lalbagh Palace, two claimants come forward
stories.description: The chest was unearthed when labourers levelling the ground for a pathway struck a metal object with a spade last week.

stories.title: NCB busts Delhi-Kashmir drug network; seizes half-a-million capsules, cough syrup bottles
stories.description: The NCB’s Jammu Zonal Unit carried out the operation in coordination with its Delhi Zonal Unit.

stories.title: Four killed, newlywed couple injured as car plunges into canal in Andhra Pradesh: Police
stories.description: The car was carrying six members of a wedding party from Tirumala to Bapatla when it hit a culvert wall and overturned into a canal near Pelluru.

stories.title: DreamCoder: Coding harness and IDE from the author of Mastering Emacs
stories.description: I talk about DreamCoder, a frontier coding harness and IDE I have been working on for quite a long time. I also talk about the history of AI, LISP and Emacs, and how it all fits together.

stories.title: How to Bypass Rust's Orphan Rule
stories.description: Hit Rust's Orphan Rule (E0117)? Skip the NewType wrappers. See how a generic context parameter decouples your models crate, with real examples from Kova.

stories.title: PostgreSQL 19: A hands-on tour with runnable browser examples
stories.description: Explore PostgreSQL 19 with live SQL, real sequence replication and standby waits, plus PostgreSQL 18 comparison recipes.

stories.title: Cyclone Akvan: IMD forecasts rain in West Bengal on Sunday
stories.description: The storm moved towards West Bengal after making landfall near Gopalpur in Odisha on Friday morning, bringing heavy rain to south Bengal.

stories.title: AI is giving everyone the same advice
stories.description: I asked 65 AIs from 30 companies the questions people ask them every day, 127,918 times. 73 of every 100 people were told to read the same book. See every answer, and the two prompts that get you your own.

stories.title: Restricting AI agents in mobile operating systems platforms from capturing data
stories.description: Privacy is our mission; it’s why we exist, and we do everything we can to protect it. This means that we are restricting the latest AI agents built into mobile operating systems from potentially capturing and storing your Signal data.

stories.title: Frostbite: A new CPU architecture discovered, designed and verified by AI
stories.description: Frostbite is a general-purpose CPU built around interaction nets, discovered, designed, and verified end-to-end by our AI systems, reaching 4.59x the performance-per-watt of a modern superscalar (dual-issue, in-order) CPU core.
